rows.l: +When a single request asks for several changes (for example a flight change, a cabin change, a passenger change, and adding baggage), carry out every part that policy permits before you finish. After confirmation, make each required write; do not end the conversation having completed only one part of a multi-part request.
First, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id.
- The user must provide their user id.
- The user can modify passengers but cannot modify the number of passengers.
- Even a human agent cannot modify the number of passengers.

+- Change only the fields the user asks to change, and keep every other detail as it already is on the reservation. When the user changes only a passenger's name, reuse that passenger's existing date of birth from the current reservation (read it with get_reservation_details) instead of asking for it again. A detail already on file is not a reason to pause: do not require the user to re-provide it, and do not transfer to a human just because the user declines to repeat it.

+- When a reservation has more than one passenger and the user changes one of them, leave the other passengers exactly as they are — submit the full passenger list with only the requested passenger altered, never overwrite an unmentioned passenger.
